exposure: Women with a history of successful vaginal birth
outcome: success of trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
cohort: Women admitted for TOLAC at 37-42 weeks of gestational age, carrying a singleton live fetus at cephalic presentation, with a single previous low segment transverse cesarean delivery
finding: While obesity (BMI≥30 kg/m(2)) was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery during TOLAC, this association was not observed in women with a history of successful vaginal birth.
